verdict.rationale: Adyen Issuing is an API-driven product, so an interactive API reference is a fair question. The evidence only describes API endpoints such as /paymentInstruments/{id} in prose docs, an llms.txt file and probes showing no OpenAPI spec at common paths; nothing documents an interactive explorer or runnable examples.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
